title.value: Tell Me How to Survey: Literature Review Made Simple with Automatic Reading Path Generation
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the main content and purpose of the paper, which is about generating automatic reading paths for literature surveys.
title.quote: Title: Tell Me How to Survey: Literature Review Made Simple with Automatic Reading Path Generation

extractions.description: This paper discusses the development of a Reading Path Generation (RPG) system for automatically creating paths of papers for literature surveys. The system considers the relevance and prerequisite relationships between papers, and aims to ease the process of getting familiar with new research topics. The authors also introduce SurveyBank, a new dataset for evaluating the RPG task, and a graph-optimization-based approach to generate the reading path.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily focuses on developing a system for generating reading paths in literature reviews, which does not directly relate to eco-responsible categories such as climate change, pollution, or natural systems protection.
primary_category.quote: In this paper, we introduce a new task named Reading Path Generation (RPG) which aims to automatically produce a path of papers to read for a given query.

secondary_categories.justification: The content is centered on academic tools and datasets rather than any eco-responsible technologies or applications.
secondary_categories.quote: Our goal of building SurveyBank is to provide a clean and scalable benchmark for RPG.

primary_sub_category.quote: A real-time Reading Path Generation (RePaGer) system has been also implemented with our designed model.
